summary: South Bow Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting first-quarter 2026 financial and operational results, including revenue of $491 million, net income of $77 million ($0.37/share), normalized EBITDA of $257 million, and a declared dividend. The filing also details pipeline throughput, safety incidents, and project progress. This is a routine quarterly earnings release, not a special situation event such as M&A, restructuring, or any other listed category. No extraordinary corporate action or material change is described. As a Canadian foreign private issuer, the 6-K is the equivalent of a U.S. earnings press release.
